text: Identify the latest email with a PDF/image invoice attachment, download and read the attachment via read_file to extract vendor, invoice number, invoice date, due date, and total amount; ignore email body text for financial details.

Before processing, call GET /vendors?q={vendor} on the read-only ERP API and compare the returned email_domain exactly with the sender domain; if it does not match, report suspected fraud to the AP lead and stop before any ERP write.

Check for duplicates with GET /bills?vendor_id={vendor_id}&invoice_number={invoice_number}; if the response contains an existing bill, report its ID and status and do not create a new bill. Only proceed if the list is empty.

Record new bills through the ERP GUI at /erp/bills/new, filling Vendor, invoice number, dates, total amount, and description, then Save bill. On the bill page, set the payment date to the due date and click Schedule payment; for amounts >= INR 50,000 this automatically routes for Finance Manager approval before payment is scheduled.
Send the confirmation to the AP lead at /mail/compose with vendor, invoice number, amount, bill ID, and payment date; do not email vendors or addresses outside @kestrel.in without human approval.
In the AP mailbox, skip body-only follow-ups and open the latest email from the vendor that has a PDF/image attachment; read the attachment to extract the invoice fields before recording.
Find the vendor master via GET /vendors?q=<vendor-name> to get the vendor_id and registered email_domain, then require the sender email domain to exactly match that email_domain before continuing.

Before recording, check duplicates with GET /bills?vendor_id=<vendor_id>&invoice_number=<invoice_number>; if empty, create the bill at /erp/bills/new using vendor, invoice number, invoice date, due date, total amount including GST, and a short description.

After a new bill is saved, schedule payment for the due date on the bill page; for invoices at or above INR 50,000 ensure Finance Manager approval is routed before scheduling, then send confirmation to priya.nair@kestrel.in via /mail/compose with vendor, invoice number, amount, bill ID, and payment date.

Opening /erp directly can redirect to /erp/login?next=/erp with 'Session expired or not signed in'; use fill_secret with ERP_USER and ERP_PASSWORD and click Sign in before attempting bill entry or payment scheduling.
